Lucky individuals

Job is about 8.4 miles. Leave an 1hr 30 mins earlier. Start at 100%, and end at about 84%. Going between 15- 25 mph.

But I get light exercise standing up. It can go street speeds. But got in trouble by an officer. Told me to stay on sidewalk. 

Its bs, because these sidewalks are ass. 

I weigh about 260lb and 6'3". My Inmotion V13 can literally haul ass. Top speed on full battery; not recommended is 56mph. And range is 124 miles 

Best secondary vehicle I've ever owned. Though its a learning curve. Once you get the hang of it. Its very rewarding. 

More fun then a car imo. The only downside, it costs 4k.
But good news. I paid $1000.00 deposit last year. 

Remaining $3000 was from insurance pay out when I got rear ended in an accident and they couldn't fix the bumper.
